description:
Check components or repositories for known security advisories before or after you reuse
    them: severity, CVSS, summary and the versions that fix each one. Cost: 0 credits (free; needs a
    free key).

    Advisories are repository-wide: OSV advisories for the packages each repository publishes
    (refreshed weekly), plus published CVE/GHSA ids from web reports. "none_known" means no advisory
    in our data, not that the code is safe.

    Parameters: component_ids -- up to 25 ids from search_components / get_component. names -- up
    to 25 repositories as "owner/repo" or a GitHub URL (a bare repo name matches every owner's).

    Returns JSON {"results": [...], "summary", "coverage", "note"}; each result has status
    "advisories" (max_severity, by_severity, the most severe advisories with summary, fixed_versions
    and links), "none_known" (with packages_checked) or "not_found".

    Example: check_component_security(component_ids=["<id>"], names=["nestjs/nest"])
name: check_component_security
title: Check component security
